title: मील का पत्थर शून्य दिखे… तो ब्रेक मत दबाना 😱 | NH-54 | Hindi Horror Story
logline: On a rainy night stretch of NH-54, a father racing home for his daughter's birthday keeps passing the same broken bridge and the same woman waving in the rain, and learns what the old dhaba owner meant by 'don't stop between thirteen and zero'.

characters.name: Raghav
characters.look: Indian man aged 35, short black hair, three-day stubble, tired eyes, crumpled blue checked full-sleeve shirt, grey trousers, black wristwatch on the left wrist, thin gold wedding ring

characters.name: Raghav (frozen)
characters.look: the same Indian man aged 35, short black hair, three-day stubble, crumpled blue checked full-sleeve shirt, grey trousers, skin deathly pale and grey, eyes wide open and unseeing, motionless, hands rigid on a steering wheel

characters.name: Kaka (dhaba owner)
characters.look: Indian roadside tea seller aged 70, short white stubble and white moustache, deep wrinkles, faded brown kurta, grey wool shawl over his shoulders, saffron cotton cloth round his neck, thin cracked spectacles

characters.name: The Woman on the Road
characters.look: a very pale thin woman in a soaked dull-red cotton saree clinging to her body, long wet black hair hanging over her entire face so no face is visible, bare feet, grey skin, long thin fingers, unnaturally still

props.look: a dusty white small hatchback car with a cracked left tail-light, a muddy lower body, a red rosary hanging from the rear-view mirror, a small child's birthday card tucked into the dashboard

scenes.setting: a dusty white hatchback seen from inside through a rain-lashed windshield at night, wipers sweeping, the dashboard clock glowing red 03:17, a stone milestone showing 0 in the headlights

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: अगर रात के सफ़र में मील का पत्थर शून्य दिखे… तो ब्रेक मत दबाना।
lines.en: If a milestone reads zero on a night drive… don't press the brake.
lines.shot: a stone milestone with a black 0 glowing in car headlights in heavy rain

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: क्योंकि वो रास्ता ख़त्म होने का नहीं… किसी के तुम्हें घेर लेने का इशारा है।
lines.en: Because it doesn't mean the road is ending… it means something is closing in on you.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: अगर किसी को ये मिले… घड़ी में तीन बजकर सत्रह मिनट हैं। और मैं दो घंटे से एक ही जगह पर हूँ।
lines.en: If anyone finds this… the clock says 3:17. And I've been in the same place for two hours.
lines.shot: a trembling hand holding a phone with a red recording dot, a red dashboard clock behind

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ये राघव की आख़िरी रिकॉर्डिंग थी।
lines.en: This was Raghav's last recording.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: पर कहानी शुरू होती है उससे कुछ घंटे पहले… एक सुनसान ढाबे पर।
lines.en: But the story begins a few hours earlier… at a deserted roadside dhaba.

scenes.continuity: the dashboard clock shows 03:17 in red; all car windows are shut

scenes.setting: a tiny roadside tea stall (dhaba) on a dark highway under one yellow bulb, rain dripping from a tin roof, a coal stove with a steel kettle, a wooden plank counter, a white hatchback parked outside

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: रात के सवा बजे थे। राघव अपने गाँव लौट रहा था।
lines.en: It was a quarter past one. Raghav was driving home to his village.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: सुबह उसकी बेटी मीनू का जन्मदिन था। केक गाड़ी की पिछली सीट पर नहीं, उसके दिल में था।
lines.en: Tomorrow was his daughter Meenu's birthday. He had promised to be there before she woke.

lines.speaker: kaka
lines.text: चाय पियोगे साहब? बाहर बारिश बहुत है।
lines.en: Tea, sir? It's pouring outside.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: हाँ काका, एक कड़क चाय। बस आधे घंटे में निकलना है।
lines.en: Yes, uncle, one strong tea. I have to leave in half an hour.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: बूढ़े ने चूल्हे से चाय उतारी… और दो गिलास रखे।
lines.en: The old man lifted the kettle off the stove… and set down two glasses.

lines.speaker: kaka
lines.text: अकेले हो?
lines.en: Alone?
lines.shot: an old tea seller looking past a young man's shoulder, his face frozen

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: हाँ काका, अकेला ही हूँ।
lines.en: Yes, uncle. Just me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: बूढ़े की नज़र राघव के पीछे गई… और वहीं ठहर गई।
lines.en: The old man's eyes went past Raghav… and stayed there.

scenes.continuity: Two steel tea glasses stand on the plank: one steaming in front of Raghav, one untouched with no steam beside it

scenes.setting: the same tiny roadside tea stall at night in rain, close on an old tea seller's weathered face lit by one yellow bulb and a young man listening

lines.speaker: kaka
lines.text: साहब, मील के पत्थर पर तेरह से शून्य तक का रास्ता है। उसमें गाड़ी कभी मत रोकना।
lines.en: Sir, between milestone thirteen and zero, never stop the car.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: काका, मैं शहर में पढ़ा हूँ। भूत-प्रेत मैं नहीं मानता। रास्ता है, बस रास्ता।
lines.en: Uncle, I studied in the city. I don't believe in ghosts. A road is just a road.

lines.speaker: kaka
lines.text: इस मोड़ के बाद शीशे ऊपर चढ़ा लेना। बाहर से कोई हाथ हिलाए, तो रुकना मत।
lines.en: After this bend, roll the windows up. If anyone waves from outside, don't stop.

lines.speaker: kaka
lines.text: वो रास्ता माँगते नहीं हैं साहब… रास्ता छीन लेते हैं।
lines.en: They don't ask for a way, sir… they take it.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: ठीक है काका। शीशे चढ़ा लूँगा।
lines.en: All right, uncle. I'll keep the windows up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: राघव मुस्कुराया। उसे नहीं पता था कि बूढ़ा उसे चेतावनी नहीं दे रहा था… बल्कि किसी और को।
lines.en: Raghav smiled. He didn't know the old man wasn't warning him… but someone else.

scenes.setting: a lonely two-lane national highway through dark flat fields at night in heavy rain, wet black asphalt shining, no other vehicles, no street lights, a white hatchback driving fast, a yellow-topped milestone reading 13 flashing past

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: तेरह। राघव ने खिड़कियाँ चढ़ाईं, रेडियो चालू किया और रफ़्तार सौ पर ले ली।
lines.en: Thirteen. Raghav rolled up the windows, switched on the radio and pushed the speed to a hundred.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: सड़क के दोनों तरफ़ बस काले खेत थे… और बारिश।
lines.en: On both sides of the road there were only black fields… and rain.
lines.shot: wipers sweeping over a rain-blurred windshield, dark fields beyond

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: बारह। ग्यारह। दस। सब कुछ सामान्य था। बहुत ज़्यादा सामान्य।
lines.en: Twelve. Eleven. Ten. Everything was normal. Far too normal.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: देखा मीनू? बाबा आ रहे हैं। तेरे उठने से पहले पहुँच जाऊँगा।
lines.en: See, Meenu? Daddy's coming. I'll be there before you wake up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: तभी रेडियो में एक आवाज़ फुसफुसाई।
lines.en: Then a voice whispered through the radio.

scenes.continuity: all car windows are shut; the dashboard clock shows 03:17

scenes.setting: the inside of a car at night, a dashboard radio glowing with static, a phone map showing a blue dot drifting off the road into blank white, rain on the windshield

lines.speaker: woman
lines.text: रुको… पीछे… रुको…
lines.en: Stop… behind… stop…

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: राघव ने झटके से रेडियो बंद कर दिया।
lines.en: Raghav switched the radio off with a jerk.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: फ़ोन का नक्शा घूमा… नीला निशान सड़क से बाहर चला गया… और नेटवर्क की आख़िरी लकीर भी बुझ गई।
lines.en: The map spun… the blue dot slid off the road… and the last bar of signal died.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: सिग्नल की दिक़्क़त है… बस और कुछ नहीं।
lines.en: Just a signal problem… nothing else.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: पर उसकी उँगलियाँ स्टीयरिंग पर कस गई थीं।
lines.en: But his fingers had tightened on the wheel.

scenes.setting: a lonely two-lane national highway through dark flat fields at night in heavy rain, wet black asphalt shining, no other vehicles, no street lights, a pale woman in a soaked dull-red saree standing at the roadside with one arm raised, wet hair hiding her face, a milestone reading 7 beside her, headlights catching her

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: सात। सड़क के किनारे बारिश में भीगी एक औरत खड़ी थी।
lines.en: Seven. A woman stood by the roadside, soaked in the rain.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: लाल साड़ी, गीले बाल चेहरे पर… और एक हाथ, धीरे-धीरे हिलता हुआ।
lines.en: Red saree, wet hair over her face… and one hand, slowly waving.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: काका ने कहा था… रुकना मत।
lines.en: Uncle said… don't stop.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उसने एक्सेलरेटर दबा दिया। औरत पीछे छूट गई।
lines.en: He pressed the accelerator. The woman fell behind.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: पर पीछे के शीशे में… वो हाथ अब भी हिल रहा था।
lines.en: But in the rear-view mirror… that hand was still waving.
lines.shot: a rear-view mirror showing a far red-saree figure with one raised hand on a dark wet road

scenes.continuity: the woman's face is never visible, hidden by wet hair; her right arm is raised

scenes.setting: a lonely two-lane national highway through dark flat fields at night in heavy rain, wet black asphalt shining, no other vehicles, no street lights, a broken concrete bridge railing and a huge bent banyan tree leaning over the road lit by headlights

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: छह। पाँच। चार।
lines.en: Six. Five. Four.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: सामने एक टूटा हुआ पुल आया। और सड़क पर झुका एक बूढ़ा बरगद।
lines.en: A broken bridge came up ahead. And an old banyan bent over the road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: राघव ने ये दोनों पहले भी देखे थे।
lines.en: Raghav had seen both of them before.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: तीन। दो। एक।
lines.en: Three. Two. One.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और फिर मील का पत्थर… शून्य।
lines.en: And then the milestone… zero.
lines.shot: a stone milestone with a black 0 in headlights

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: अगले ही मोड़ पर… फिर तेरह।
lines.en: On the very next bend… thirteen again.
lines.shot: a stone milestone with a black 13 in headlights

scenes.setting: the inside of a car at night, close on a red dashboard clock frozen at 03:17, a speedometer needle at 100, a man's sweating face lit red, a phone in his hand with a red recording dot

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: घड़ी तीन बजकर सत्रह मिनट पर रुकी हुई थी। सूई सौ पर अटकी थी।
lines.en: The clock was stuck at 3:17. The speedometer was stuck at a hundred.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: ये क्या हो रहा है… तेल का काँटा भी वहीं का वहीं है।
lines.en: What is happening… even the fuel needle hasn't moved.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उसने काँपते हाथों से फ़ोन निकाला और रिकॉर्डिंग चालू कर दी।
lines.en: With shaking hands he pulled out his phone and started recording.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: मैं पिछले दो घंटे से सौ की रफ़्तार पर चल रहा हूँ… लेकिन ये पेड़, ये टूटा हुआ पुल… वही जगह बार-बार आ रही है।
lines.en: I've been doing a hundred for two hours… but this tree, this broken bridge… the same place keeps coming back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: बाहर बारिश की आवाज़ थी। अंदर, उसके अपने दिल की।
lines.en: Outside was the sound of rain. Inside, the sound of his own heart.

scenes.continuity: the dashboard clock reads 03:17 and the speedometer needle rests at 100

scenes.setting: a lonely two-lane national highway through dark flat fields at night in heavy rain, wet black asphalt shining, no other vehicles, no street lights, a white hatchback speeding past a milestone reading 7, the pale woman in the soaked red saree now standing in the middle of the road with her arm raised

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: तीसरी बार। सात का पत्थर।
lines.en: The third time. Milestone seven.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: इस बार वो औरत किनारे पर नहीं थी… सड़क के बीचों-बीच खड़ी थी।
lines.en: This time the woman wasn't on the roadside… she stood in the middle of the road.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: हट जाओ! हट जाओ!
lines.en: Move! Get out of the way!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: राघव ने आँखें बंद कर लीं। टक्कर नहीं हुई।
lines.en: Raghav shut his eyes. There was no impact.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: गाड़ी उसके आर-पार निकल गई। और अंदर एक बर्फ़ीली हवा भर गई।
lines.en: The car passed right through her. And an icy wind filled the car.

scenes.continuity: the car windows stay shut; the woman's face is hidden by wet hair

scenes.setting: the rear-view mirror of a car at night showing the back seat, a figure with long wet hair sitting low in the back seat with her head tilted, a man's wide eyes reflected beside it

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: तभी राघव की नज़र पिछले शीशे पर गई।
lines.en: Then Raghav's eyes fell on the rear-view mirror.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: पिछली सीट पर कोई बैठा था। सिर झुका हुआ। गीले बाल।
lines.en: Someone was sitting in the back seat. Head bowed. Wet hair.
lines.shot: a rear-view mirror showing a wet-haired figure sitting in the back seat

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उसने गर्दन घुमाई… सीट ख़ाली थी। बस सीट भीगी हुई थी।
lines.en: He turned his head… the seat was empty. Only the seat was soaked.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उसने फिर शीशे में देखा… और सिर थोड़ा और पास झुक चुका था।
lines.en: He looked into the mirror again… and the head had bent a little closer.
lines.shot: a rear-view mirror with the wet-haired head now much closer, almost at his shoulder

scenes.continuity: the back seat is empty and soaked when seen directly; the figure is seen only in the mirror

scenes.setting: the inside of a car at night, a man gripping the steering wheel staring at the mirror, in the mirror a wet-haired woman's hidden face very close behind his shoulder

lines.speaker: woman
lines.text: तुमने मुझे लिफ़्ट तो नहीं दी…
lines.en: You didn't give me a lift…

lines.speaker: woman
lines.text: पर तुम्हारी पिछली सीट पर जगह बहुत ख़ाली थी।
lines.en: But there was so much empty space on your back seat.

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: कौन हो तुम? तुम्हें क्या चाहिए?
lines.en: Who are you? What do you want?

lines.speaker: woman
lines.text: तेरह से शून्य तक… रास्ता कोई भी चला सकता है। बस रुकना नहीं चाहिए।
lines.en: From thirteen to zero… anyone can drive this road. They just must never stop.

lines.speaker: woman
lines.text: मैं रास्ता नहीं माँगती… मुझे तुम्हारी जगह चाहिए।
lines.en: I don't ask for the road… I want your place.

scenes.continuity: the woman is only a reflection in the mirror, face hidden by wet hair

scenes.setting: the inside of a car at night, a man sobbing over the steering wheel, a small child's birthday card on the dashboard, a milestone with a black 0 glowing ahead through the rain

lines.speaker: raghav
lines.text: नहीं… मुझे घर जाना है। आज मेरी मीनू का जन्मदिन है।
lines.en: No… I have to go home. It's my Meenu's birthday today.

lines.speaker: woman
lines.text: सब यही कहते हैं।
lines.en: Everyone says that.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: बारिश तेज़ हो गई। हेडलाइट की रोशनी में मील का पत्थर चमका।
lines.en: The rain grew harder. A milestone gleamed in the headlights.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: शून्य।
lines.en: Zero.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और राघव ने वही किया… जो काका ने मना किया था।
lines.en: And Raghav did exactly what the old man had forbidden.

scenes.setting: a white hatchback braking hard in the rain beside a yellow milestone with a black 0, headlights glaring, spray flying, dark empty fields

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: राघव ने पूरी ताक़त से ब्रेक दबा दिया।
lines.en: Raghav slammed the brake with all his strength.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: गाड़ी चीख़ती हुई रुकी। इंजन बंद हुआ। बारिश की आवाज़ भी बंद हो गई।
lines.en: The car screamed to a halt. The engine died. Even the sound of the rain stopped.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: सन्नाटा। ऐसा सन्नाटा, जो कानों में चुभता है।
lines.en: Silence. A silence that pricks the ears.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और उस सन्नाटे में, पिछली सीट से किसी के उतरने की आवाज़ आई।
lines.en: And in that silence came the sound of someone stepping down from the back seat.

scenes.setting: a lonely wet highway at night, a man in a blue checked shirt standing beside a white hatchback with the driver door open, rain falling around him but not touching him, a milestone with a black 0 nearby

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: राघव दरवाज़ा खोलकर बाहर कूद गया।
lines.en: Raghav threw the door open and jumped out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: अजीब बात थी। बारिश उसके चारों तरफ़ गिर रही थी… पर उसे भिगो नहीं रही थी।
lines.en: Strangely, rain was falling all around him… but it wasn't wetting him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उसके कदमों की आवाज़ भी नहीं आ रही थी।
lines.en: Even his footsteps made no sound.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: वो धीरे-धीरे लौटा और ड्राइवर की खिड़की से अंदर झाँका।
lines.en: Slowly he went back and looked in through the driver's window.

scenes.continuity: Raghav's shirt is completely dry although rain falls around him

scenes.setting: through a car's driver window at night, a pale man in a blue checked shirt sitting rigid at the steering wheel with open staring eyes and hands frozen on the wheel, the broken bridge faintly visible behind

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: स्टीयरिंग पर कोई बैठा था। हाथ पहिये पर जमे हुए। आँखें खुली, पर बेजान।
lines.en: Someone sat at the steering wheel. Hands frozen on the wheel. Eyes open, but lifeless.
lines.shot: a pale man's frozen hands gripping a car steering wheel, wet dashboard glass

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: वो राघव था।
lines.en: It was Raghav.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: तीन बजकर सत्रह मिनट पर, इसी मोड़ पर, उसकी गाड़ी टूटे पुल से नीचे गिरी थी।
lines.en: At 3:17, at this very bend, his car had gone off the broken bridge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: वो पुल, वो पेड़, वो घड़ी… ये सब उसकी आख़िरी साँस थी, जो ख़त्म ही नहीं हुई।
lines.en: The bridge, the tree, the clock… all of it was his last breath, and it never ended.

scenes.continuity: Raghav stands outside; the pale motionless Raghav sits inside gripping the wheel; the car is dented and dusty

scenes.setting: a white hatchback with headlights glowing starting by itself on a dark wet highway and driving away, a man in a blue checked shirt left standing at the roadside, taillights shrinking into rain

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: तभी गाड़ी अपने आप स्टार्ट हुई। हेडलाइट जल उठीं।
lines.en: Then the car started on its own. The headlights blazed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: औरत पिछली सीट से उठकर आगे आई। और उस जगह बैठ गई, जो कभी राघव की थी।
lines.en: The woman moved from the back seat to the front. And sat down in the place that had been Raghav's.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: गाड़ी आगे बढ़ गई। राघव को उसी सड़क पर छोड़कर।
lines.en: The car drove away. Leaving Raghav on that same road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: उसकी मीनू का जन्मदिन… कभी नहीं आया।
lines.en: Meenu's birthday… never came for him.

scenes.setting: a lonely wet highway at night, a man in a blue checked shirt standing at the roadside with one arm slowly rising, in the far distance the glow of oncoming headlights through rain, a milestone reading 7

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: दूर से एक और गाड़ी की हेडलाइट दिखाई दी।
lines.en: Far away, another car's headlights appeared.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: राघव का हाथ अपने आप ऊपर उठने लगा।
lines.en: Raghav's hand began to rise on its own.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: वो मदद नहीं माँग रहा था। उसे बस… हाथ हिलाना था।
lines.en: He wasn't asking for help. He simply… had to wave.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और वो हिलता रहा। धीरे-धीरे। हर आने वाली गाड़ी के लिए।
lines.en: And he kept waving. Slowly. For every car that came.

scenes.continuity: Raghav's right arm is raised and waving; his face is calm and empty

scenes.setting: the same tiny roadside tea stall at night in rain under one yellow bulb, an old tea seller handing two steel glasses of tea to a new traveller with a bag, a different car parked outside

lines.speaker: kaka
lines.text: साहब, इस मोड़ के बाद शीशे ऊपर चढ़ा लेना।
lines.en: Sir, after this bend, roll your windows up.

lines.speaker: kaka
lines.text: बाहर से कोई हाथ हिलाए, तो रुकना मत।
lines.en: If anyone waves from outside, don't stop.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: और बूढ़े ने मेज़ पर दो गिलास रख दिए।
lines.en: And the old man set two glasses on the plank.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: अगर कभी रात के सफ़र में मील का पत्थर शून्य दिखे… तो ब्रेक मत दबाना।
lines.en: If you ever see a milestone reading zero on a night drive… don't press the brake.

scenes.continuity: two steel tea glasses on the plank, one steaming and one with no steam

youtube.description:
On a rain-soaked night stretch of NH-54, a father racing home for his daughter's birthday keeps passing the same broken bridge, the same bent banyan tree and the same woman waving from the roadside. A tea-stall owner had warned him: never stop between milestone thirteen and zero. This is a Hindi horror story about a haunted highway.

The highway ghost legend is fiction inspired by Indian roadside folklore; all characters and events are made up.
